ejemplo.text:
Jo e me amigu caminàm per la montanheta de Salís quan vèiem una gran quantitat de bolets. Encontram nos a un pinar prop del crestèlh. 

Tradus en English: We and my friend were walking on the Salís mountain when we saw an enormous amount of mushrooms. We found ourselves in a pine forest near a ridge.
